details:
*This feedback is being submitted on behalf of my friend.

When EAC (Easy Anti-Cheat) finishes loading and waits for the game window to launch, the VRChat game window does not appear after the EAC window disappears. At the same time, Steam can no longer detect that VRChat is running (the status changes from "In-Game" to "Online"). However, both the EAC and VRChat processes still appear in Task Manager, with the VRChat process showing almost no resource usage.

After testing, it was found that directly opening VRChat.exe (bypassing EAC) allows the VRChat game window to launch and run normally. Launching the game through luncher.exe results in the same issue, and Steam fails to detect VRChat running at all.

Methods already attempted:

Verifying file integrity

Uninstalling and reinstalling EAC

Reinstalling the game

Repairing runtime libraries

Repairing the system

Restarting the computer

Troubleshooting network issues

Switching game versions

None of these solutions worked.

Using mechanical translation
title: The VRChat application window won't open correctly.
